Introduction

Riracha Phondechaphiphat, known under her stage name Chiquita, is a Thai singer, rapper and dancer under YG Entertainment. She is best known for being a member of the girl group BABYMONSTER. She made her official debut on November 27, 2023 with the group's digital single "Batter Up".
